id: title:Gilbert09:re list app store connect segments before download

review.posthog_relevance: Apple App Store Connect warehouse ingestion; presigned URLs expire quickly, so caching the probe results before download could serve stale URLs. This hunk removes the cache and re-fetches segments immediately before download, preventing expired URL errors.
review.reason: The observed hunk P1.F1.H3 removes a caching mechanism for presigned URLs used in Apple App Store Connect warehouse ingestion. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement: it prevents the ingestion of stale or expired URLs, which could cause failures or data loss.
